description: Named room sizes are based on total tile area. A room's area is width times height in tiles.
notes: Area bands are inclusive for now.
If a boundary value appears in two bands, prefer the smaller named size unless the user explicitly asks otherwise.
Examples: 3x3 is small because it is 9 tiles. 3x4 is small because it is 12 tiles. 4x5 is medium because it is 20 tiles. 5x6 is large because it is 30 tiles.
